title: Bang Tao vs Laguna Phuket: Comparison for Property Buyers
description: Bang Tao vs Laguna Phuket compared: resort community or open beach area, project types, advertised prices and status from our catalogue.
sub: Open beach area or integrated resort community
intro: Laguna Phuket sits on Bang Tao Bay, so the two are neighbours, but they offer different ways of living. Bang Tao is the beach area itself. Laguna is a large managed resort community with its own lagoons, golf and hotels. This guide compares what our catalogue lists in each.

p: Bang Tao is a long beach on Phuket’s west coast in the Choeng Thale (Cherng Talay) subdistrict. Projects range from condominiums to villa communities.

Laguna Phuket is an integrated resort community on Bang Tao Bay. According to its operator it covers more than 1,000 acres with lagoons, golf and a beach club, and it includes hotels and residential estates such as Laguna Lakelands and Laguna Park.
Each project is counted in one area only: those inside Laguna and its residential estates under Laguna, the rest under Bang Tao.

ul: Bang Tao: a mix of local shops, restaurants and beach clubs, with more variety of price and project style.
Laguna: a managed environment with shared resort facilities, which also means resort rules and fees. Ask what is included.
Both are in the north-west, farther from the airport than Nai Yang and Mai Khao but closer than the south.
For Laguna: which resort facilities residents can use and at what cost.
For both: the nearest beach distance from the specific project, since projects inside Laguna are not all on the beach.
Ownership type and foreign quota for each project.

faq.q: Is Laguna part of Bang Tao?
faq.a: Laguna sits on Bang Tao Bay. In our catalogue it has its own page and each project is listed on only one of the two pages.

faq.q: Which one is better for a family?
faq.a: It depends on budget and lifestyle. Both have schools and services nearby; see the Nearby section of each project.
